subject: Pilot runway request — SFTP adapter integration lag (extension & credits)
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@finrack.io>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinRack Legal <legal@finrack.io>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Pilot runway request — SFTP adapter outage blocking integration

Hi Kimberly,

Quick note from our side — our engineering lead flagged a blocker this morning. Our payments team pushed an unexpected change to the vendor SFTP endpoint that broke the adapter we were going to use for batch reconciliation. The vendor is slow to respond and our backend team is now blocked on the connector work.

We were really hoping to have the pilot fully integrated this week to finish end-to-end tests, but the change means the earliest our devs can rework and validate is ~3 weeks from now (vendor permitting). Given that, can Redwood extend the pilot window and provide supplemental sandbox credits?

Specifically we are requesting: 1) a four-week extension to the pilot start window, and 2) an additional 200k token sandbox credit so we can continue simulated runs while we sort the adapter.

I attached a short log excerpt from our CI that shows the adapter failure. Happy to hop on a call — available today afternoon (ET).

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Director of Integrations, FinRack
elena.torres@finrack.io

Attachment: SFTP-integration-log.txt

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@finrack.io>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, FinRack Legal <legal@finrack.io>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway request — SFTP adapter outage blocking integration

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick heads-up and for the logs. Sorry to hear the vendor change caught you off-guard.

Short answer: we want you to be able to complete the evaluation and we'll do what we can to help. I can provision an interim sandbox credit boost immediately while we confirm the timeline with engineering.

Proposed immediate offer:
- 25k token sandbox credit applied today so you can continue smoke tests and validation in parallel.
- A pilot extension of 2 weeks while our infra/eng team assesses the vendor impact.

I’m looping in Dev (dev_patel) and Marissa from CS to weigh in on the feasibility and whether we can stretch to a larger credit / longer extension given the engineering estimate. If you need more runway than 2 weeks, please say so and provide any constraints from legal (CC’d).

Can we schedule a 30-min sync this afternoon (ET)? I can get our solutions engineer on the call to review the logs and propose short-term workarounds.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0192

From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway request — SFTP adapter outage blocking integration

Internal assessment attached below (summary):
- Root cause: vendor changed SFTP auth from key-based to host-scoped certs; adapter code assumes key exchange.
- Fix scope: code change in connector + QA against vendor sandbox + one-week regression cycle.
- Estimated effort: 10-12 engineering days (2 engineers) + coordination with vendor (lead time uncertain).
- Risk: if vendor support remains slow, dependency locks could add another 1-2 weeks.

Recommendation: approve a 3-week pilot extension and 100k token sandbox credit so FinRack can continue functional/integration testing in parallel. We can provision a 25k immediate credit to buy time, then bump to the agreed amount upon manager sign-off. Also recommend scheduling a technical checkpoint with vendor and our solutions-engineer in the next 48 hours.

If leadership needs a cost/credit table I can spin one up today.

- Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer (inference integrations)

Hi Elena — quick update from our side after engineering looked through the logs.

We can approve the following as a one-off to keep your pilot on track:
1) Pilot extension: 3 weeks added to your existing pilot window (new end date = 2026-12-22).
2) Sandbox credits: 100k tokens applied within the next 24 hours (25k immediately, 75k a day after we receive an acknowledgement from your engineering lead).
3) Two dedicated solutions-engineer hours to work with your dev team on a short-term adapter workaround (we’ll schedule these ASAP).

Next steps for FinRack: please reply-all confirming acceptance of the above. Once you confirm, I’ll route the pilot-amendment-draft.pdf to Legal for a quick signature (I’ve included the draft as an attachment). If Legal needs formal wording changes, we can iterate but the credit/extension commitment stands while we resolve contractual language.

If helpful I can also open a HubSpot task and attach the DocuSign link so FinRack can sign electronically.

Thanks — let me know whether we should proceed with the immediate 25k credit before signature.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
